summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of $500 million 4.625% senior unsecured notes due 2031 by its wholly-owned finance subsidiary Rentokil Terminix Funding plc, guaranteed by the Company. The notes were offered under Rule 144A and Regulation S, and will be listed on Euronext Dublin. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment. This is a routine debt offering without special-situation characteristics such as a change of control, restructuring, or activist activity.
